title: CAPIT States | Compare Well Plugging by State
description: Explore CAPIT's state pages for plugged-well records, source agencies, recent activity, and coverage notes.
headline: Explore Well Plugging by State
body: Browse the states CAPIT currently covers, compare high-level activity, and open each state page for its source agency, definitions, recent records, and coverage notes.

sections.heading: Tracking Regional Infrastructure
sections.body: A useful state comparison does more than rank totals. Each state page shows its coverage, update schedule, and the regulatory agency behind the numbers.

sections.heading: How to Read State Comparisons
sections.body: Before comparing states, keep these points in mind:
bullets: Counts show records CAPIT has published for each state, not necessarily every well the state has plugged.
Large producing states plug far more wells than any single panel suggests. Texas Railroad Commission statistics show more than 8,000 wells plugged in each of 2024 and 2025.
States refresh their data on different schedules. Each state page shows its latest refresh date.
Status definitions differ, so compare trends within a state before comparing totals across states.

sections.heading: Sources
sections.body: Context figures on this page come from:
bullets: [Texas Railroad Commission, monthly well plugging statistics (December 2025)](https://www.rrc.texas.gov/media/c02mui0q/december-2025.pdf)
